title: bee AuditEvent
description: One structured record of a denied (enforce) or would-be-denied (observe) operation, emitted from the kernel ring buffer to user space (FR-007).

ts.description: ISO-8601 wall-clock time, mapped from the kernel monotonic ts_ns at the user-space boundary.

scope_id.description: bee scope identifier (unique within the owning process).

cgroup_id.description: cgroup v2 inode id of the governing policy scope (map key).

executor_cgroup_id.description: Immediate child cgroup of the policy scope at event time, or the scope itself. Identifies a durable batch executor across its subprocess cgroups.

op.description: Operation the LSM hook was evaluating.

decision.description: denied = blocked (enforce mode). observed = would-deny but allowed (observe/dry-run mode, FR-016).

errno.description: Negative errno the hook returned on deny (e.g. -13 EACCES, -1 EPERM). 0 in observe mode.

target.description: Resolved path (file_open/exec) or 'addr:port' (connect). May be truncated to 255 bytes.
